lines.text: Hi, Endmin. Wait. These are the goods I ordered! Oh, I can't believe you made the deliveries personally. And they look perfect. Thank you so much.
Perfect timing, Endmin! I've pinpointed why the control module failed, just waiting on...
Thanks for delivering these goods, Endmin. They're all experimental materials, and in perfect condition. Appreciate your hard work!
Yeah, reconstruction's no joke. The mineral demands are insane... Endmin, these supplies you keep delivering are a lifesaver. Thank you.
Good to see you again, Endmin. Never properly thanked you for the research materials last time.
Wait. Isn't this the order I placed? The Endministrator ... making deliveries in person? Let me check... Yep, everything's here. Thank you!
Research materials are running low again... Good thing your deliveries always arrive right on time. Yep, everything's accounted for. Thanks!
Give me a sec, I gotta make a count... The goods look great, Endmin. Awesome and reliable as always. Thanks for the delivery.
Endmin! You got something for me? Wait ... oh my goodness, the Endmin just delivered my order! Of course it's not a problem! And that goes for the goods as well!
Endmin! I can't believe you made this delivery for me... The goods are in great condition. Don't let me get in the way of your work!
Good.
Flawless.
Endmin? Thanks for making the trip! These goods look good to go.
This depot node's like a bridge connecting the entire Valley IV as one cohesive unit. Thanks, Endmin.
Good to see you again, Endmin. Your deliveries always come through for us.
Just set it here. I'll log it in once I finish what I'm working on. Let me check... Yep, quantities and categories all correct. Thank you so much!
Goods confirmed... Thanks- wait, are you ... the Endministrator?

I've heard your name since I was a kid from the elders! When I caught wind of your exploits at the Æther Test Site recently, I wondered if I'd ever get to meet you... And now here you are in the flesh!
Well then, thanks for delivering in person, Endmin! See you next time.
Endmin! It's you again! I was just wondering if you'd be making this delivery. So glad to see you once more!
Let me check these goods real quick... Yep, flawless as always! Well then, looking forward to seeing you next time, Endmin!
Huh? Aren't you the Endministrator? I saw you with the support troops a while back. I joined the effort with some other workers and spotted you then!
Oh right, let me give it a check... They're all good! Thanks Endmin, see ya.
Hi, Endmin. Hold on, give me a second... Perfect! Catch you later.
The goods match the order perfectly. Appreciate you making this delivery.
Wait, you look familiar... Hey, aren't you the Endministrator? Why are you delivering personally?
Whether it's saving us or delivering these supplies, thank you.
Well ... looks good to me, all in great condition. Appreciate you hauling this up here, Endmin.
Hiyah! Wait! You're the Endmin? I saw you working really hard on the other side!
Goods?! Wow! This is one quick delivery! I only made the order not too long ago. Let me see. Yeah. Looks great to me. Thanks a million.
You're here again, Endmin. Another delivery...? Hmm. Looks good. Thanks for making the trip.
How about a break? I'll brew some tea... Oh. Okay. Go do your thing.
Greetings, Endministrator. Sorry, I was reading a research report and didn't notice you...
What? Did I order these? Oh, I totally didn't expect you to personally deliver this. Thanks a lot, Endmin.
Great! My experiment has been waiting for these supplies. Really appreciate this delivery, Endmin.
Hmm? Endmin? Why are you here? Oh, I think I know. Hold on... Yeah, the goods are great. Thanks for the delivery. Take care.
Hmm... I completed the inventory check prescribed in the Watchguard's Handbook. The supplies look good. Thanks and take care.
